import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

export function saveCount(): Promise<void> {
  return Promise.resolve();
}

export function readCount(): Promise<number> {
  return Promise.resolve(1);
}

export function wrapLoader<T>(load: () => Promise<T>) {
  return () => load();
}

export function maybeCount(): number | undefined {
  return [1].at(1);
}

export function useCount() {
  return useQuery({ queryKey: ["count"], queryFn: readCount });
}
